usedFor: anny holds bookings, customers and invoices, and MailerLite turns them into subscribers through “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in anny, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: Each new booking creates the subscriber, or updates an existing one, so no one is added by hand.

watchOut: “Updated Booking” in anny runs on every booking change, so the same subscriber can be updated many times.
